record.field: Flag a machine for maintenance. Use after incidents where follow-up is needed — e.g. disk replacement, memory check, or planned service.

async def execute(machine, message, severity="warning"): """Flag a machine for maintenance.""" # Find or create maintenance equipment record Equipment = env.get("maintenance.equipment") if not Equipment: return "ERROR: maintenance.equipment model not available"
equipment = Equipment.search([("name", "ilike", machine)], limit=1) if not equipment: equipment = Equipment.create({ "name": machine, "category_id": env["maintenance.equipment.category"].search([ ("name", "=", "Infrastructure") ], limit=1).id or False, })
# Post a message on the equipment severity_icon = {"info": "ℹ️", "warning": "⚠️", "critical": "🔴"}.get(severity, "⚠️") equipment.message_post( body=f"{severity_icon} **Infrastructure Operator — Maintenance Notice**\n\n{message}", message_type="notification", )
return f"Maintenance notice posted on {machine}: {message[:80]}..."
